title: Kinetic Flat
description: Un style d'illustration numérique très dynamique, caractérisé par une perspective forcée extrême et des blocs de couleurs vibrantes. Il fusionne des formes vectorielles nettes sans contours avec de doux dégradés granuleux et des lignes de vitesse stylisées pour exprimer un mouvement intense.
description_en: A highly dynamic digital illustration style characterized by extreme forced perspective and vibrant color blocking. It merges crisp, lineless vector shapes with soft, stippled grain gradients and stylized speed lines to convey intense motion.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique très dynamique, caractérisé par une perspective forcée extrême et des blocs de couleurs vibrantes. Il fusionne des formes vectorielles nettes sans contours avec de doux dégradés granuleux et des lignes de vitesse stylisées pour exprimer un mouvement intense.
prompt: A highly dynamic digital illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The artwork employs extreme forced perspective, dramatic foreshortening, and a pronounced low angle to create a profound sense of kinetic energy, velocity, and monumental scale. Rendered in a sleek modern editorial style, it masterfully combines crisp, lineless vector-style shape blocking with soft, stippled grain gradients for volumetric shading. The color palette is vibrant and graphic, featuring a dominant {{primary_color}} with striking {{accent_color}} highlights and grounding, tinted {{secondary_color}} shadows. Lighting is bright, sunny, and diffuse, casting soft, colorful drop shadows that integrate seamlessly into the textured environment, avoiding harsh blacks. Background and environmental elements are deliberately stretched into stylized horizontal speed lines and sweeping color bands, simulating intense motion blur and rapid forward momentum. Edges on the central focal elements remain razor-sharp and clean, while peripheral details dissolve into streaky, painterly sweeps of color. The overall surface exhibits a subtle, tactile paper noise and fine digital stippling, adding warmth and organic texture to the otherwise flat geometric color fields. The structural composition is heavily reliant on sweeping diagonals and converging lines to pull the viewer into the scene. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. dynamic perspective, dramatic foreshortening, editorial illustration, digital grain, stippled shading, lineless vector, speed lines, stylized motion blur, vibrant color blocking, sweeping diagonals, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Subjects and background elements streak across the frame with stylized, horizontal motion blur and dynamic speed lines, emphasizing extreme velocity.
video.camera: The camera maintains a dramatic, low-angle forced perspective, tracking forward rapidly to enhance the sensation of speed.
video.temporal_texture: Digital grain and stippled shading remain locked to the surfaces of moving objects, while background speed lines continuously streak and regenerate.
video.avoid: Avoid realistic physics, smooth 3D motion blur, static compositions, or the loss of the textured, grainy gradient aesthetic during movement.
